tools.name: ask_stores
tools.description: Asks the independent online stores that sell this kind of product and returns each store's own offer: product, price, stock, a picture and a link to the product on the store's site. tools.name: shop_for_wish
tools.description: Takes what the person wants, in any language: the product or who it is for, a budget, the country. Returns stores' offers, or one question when it names no product. To go on, call again with the person's answer and the `record` the last answer gave. Nothing is bought.

tools.name: store_delivery
tools.description: What stores' own shipping policies say: the countries they ship to, the days, the cost or a free-shipping threshold. Pass the `domain` of offers (at most 12) and the buyer's country. A fact a policy does not state is left empty; the store shows the exact cost of an order.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The kinds of product the stores answer in, with how many stores answer in each. A slug narrows ask_stores.

tools.name: about_network
tools.description: How this connector works: where the offers come from, how they are ordered, and which goods it leaves out.
